S.FORM: == Andre Barrett == siwkay niza Andre Barrett(2 a bulad 21 a demiad, 1982 a mihcaan), tatama, lumeniaya a tademaw. caay ka talakaw. u miunduay , u kanas-mali a mimaliay nu Amilika NBA. kakuniza kalunasulitan-sulu u nasulitan nu Hulam atu Amilika 安卓·巴雷特,為美國NBA . Andre Rashawd Barrett (born February 21, 1982) is an American professional basketball player who last played for Obras Sanitarias of the Liga Nacional de Básquet. He played college basketball for Seton Hall.
